claim_as_published: 'No approval needed up to US$50,000/day on ID documents' as a general statement about wiring money out of China
official_source_title: 2024年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（三） (SAFE Tianjin, quoting 汇发〔2020〕14号 art. 64)
verbatim_quote: 境内个人外汇汇出境外用于经常项目支出……外汇账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、有交易额的相关材料办理。……持外币现钞汇出当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、经海关签章的《海关申报单》或本人原存款银行外币现钞提取单据、有交易额的相关材料办理。
action_taken: The ID-only US$50,000 same-day threshold is expressly for 境内个人 (DOMESTIC individuals) remitting FX FROM AN FX ACCOUNT for current-account expenditure, and it is US$10,000/day when remitting foreign-currency CASH. A U.S. citizen is a 境外个人 (foreign individual) - see RC-06. Every place the site stated the blanket rule now carries its scope: M01 'why', M07 step 3, dashboard fact 4, and the executive summary.

claim_as_published: Document requirements for a FOREIGN individual (境外个人) buying FX out of CNY income earned in China
official_source_title: 2024年经常项目外汇政策问答案例（九）— 境外个人是否享受年度便利化额度购汇？ (SAFE Tianjin, quoting 汇发〔2020〕14号 art. 59)
verbatim_quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。
action_taken: This is the rule that actually governs the user's case: a U.S. citizen buying FX out of lawful current-account CNY income earned in China must present a valid ID PLUS source-of-funds documents showing the transaction amount, INCLUDING TAX CERTIFICATES (含税务凭证). The annual purchase convenience quota is available only to foreign individuals holding a 外国人永久居留身份证 (Foreign Permanent Resident ID). Added to the S775 register as S52 and wired into M01 and the dashboard.
